note: Written every night from the Todoist project Balance by tools/balance.py. `automatic` is that project's 'Runs without me' section, `by_hand` is everything else. Change the project, not this file: edits here are overwritten.

automatic.what: Searches the web and emails a weekly digest of real local events, near Appomattox and across Pennsylvania
The same digest, tuned for a ceramics residency and its resident artists
Reads the mail for anything the radar business needs answering, checks the digest actually went out, and prepares the replies
Posts one note to Substack for The Wild Clay Hunt, word for word from the written bank, never composing
Checks every publication's schedule and starts whatever is due
Writes the Monday issue of Small Notes, Big Changes straight into Substack as a draft
Writes the weekly Wild Clay Hunt issue into Substack as a draft, never publishing
Reads the publication dashboards and records the numbers
Asks the month-one questions about the residency pilot: retention, quote, billing, one introduction

by_hand.what: Listing new pieces to the shop
Instagram, finding who to talk to and what to post
Working on the Wild Clay Archive
Looking for something digital worth selling, out of work already happening
Going to an event from the radar
Preparing a month of writing for every publication
Looking at what worked, what did not, and what to hand over next
